chapters.title: Natural One to the Face
chapters.goal: Artie dies in a freak vending machine accident and wakes up in the 'Death-Trap Tutorial' of a broken LitRPG world.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane debt-ridden existence to immediate survival against level-scaled monstrosities.

bridge.from_prev: Artie's previous life as a failed actuary.
bridge.to_next: Artie escapes the tutorial with a broken 'Crit-and-Quit' passive but zero actual gear.

chapters.title: The Art of Not Being Hit
chapters.goal: Artie reaches the starter town and realizes his 'Luck' stat is so high it breaks the local economy and aggros the guards.
chapters.stakes_shift: From avoiding death to avoiding incarceration while trying to monetize his glitchy existence.

bridge.to_next: Artie is forced to take a high-risk contract to pay off his 'bounty' for existing.

chapters.title: Carry Me, Maybe?
chapters.goal: Artie joins a group of 'Heroic' paladins, pretending to be a legendary glass cannon while actually just exploiting line-of-sight bugs.
chapters.stakes_shift: From solo survival to managing a reputation he hasn't earned while investigating the party's true mission.

bridge.to_next: The party discovers a dungeon that shouldn't exist according to the world map.

chapters.title: The 0.01% Probability
chapters.goal: Artie must solo-clear the dungeon boss when his party is paralyzed, relying entirely on a chain of 1-in-a-million critical hits.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a 'fake' hero to becoming a genuine, albeit terrified, powerhouse.

bridge.to_next: The boss drops an item that reveals the System is failing.

chapters.title: Divide by Zero
chapters.goal: Artie tracks down an 'Admin Ghost' to understand why his crits are breaking the reality-stability of the world.
chapters.stakes_shift: From personal progression to the potential collapse of the entire game world.

bridge.to_next: Artie realizes he needs to 'rob' the world's highest-level NPC to fix the leak.

chapters.title: The Grand Larceny of Reality
chapters.goal: Artie executes a high-speed heist on the Capital's vault to steal the 'Source Core' before the System deletes him as a bug.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a fugitive to holding the keys to the world's source code.

bridge.from_prev: The plan to infiltrate the Capital.
bridge.to_next: The heist succeeds, but triggers a world-wide 'Emergency Maintenance' event.

chapters.title: Logging Off is for Losers
chapters.goal: Artie survives the initial maintenance purge and establishes a 'safe zone' for other 'glitched' players.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lone exploiter to the reluctant leader of a digital rebellion.

bridge.to_next: Artie prepares for the inevitable 'Patch 2.0' that will try to erase him.
